To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the use of nanoparticles for SPECT and/or PET imaging is a promising approach to improve the sensitivity of molecular imaging; (b) the use of SPECT and/or positron emission tomography (PET) for molecular imaging is a promising way to improve the sensitivity and specificity of the diagnosis and monitoring of disease; and (c) the use of molecular imaging for diagnosis and therapy is a promising way of achieving personalized medicine.
the combination of the use of nanoparticles and the development of new radiotracers can provide a powerful tool for the diagnosis and treatment of diseases.
